SettingsHome.title: Settings
SettingsHome.description: Everything you can configure, grouped by what it applies to.
SettingsHome.noResultsBody: Try a shorter word, or clear the search to see everything again.
SettingsHome.emptyBody: Settings you can change appear here. Ask a workspace administrator if you need one.
SettingsHome.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No settings match} one {# setting matches} other {# settings match}}

SettingsAvailability.managedBody: This is set up once for everyone on this instance, so there's nothing to change here. Ask your administrator if it needs to be different.
SettingsAvailability.notEnabledBody: This Connex instance doesn't have this switched on, so there's nothing to set up yet. Ask your administrator if you need it.
SettingsAvailability.askAdminBody: Your role doesn't include this setting. A workspace admin can change it for you, or give you access to it.

SettingsPersonalProfile.description: Your personal details, and how you appear to the people you work with in every workspace.
SettingsPersonalProfile.metaDescription: Update your name, photo, email address, time zone, and language.

SettingsPersonalSecurity.description: How you sign in to Connex. These settings follow your account, not this workspace.
SettingsPersonalSecurity.metaDescription: Manage the passkeys you sign in with.

SettingsPersonalConnections.metaDescription: Connect your mailbox and calendar, choose what Connex may capture, and review what it held back.

SettingsPersonalNotifications.description: What Connex tells you about, where it reaches you, and the hours it should stay quiet.
SettingsPersonalNotifications.metaDescription: Choose which notifications reach you in Connex and by email, and set your quiet hours.

SettingsPersonalWorkspaces.description: The invitations waiting for you, and the workspaces you have already joined.
SettingsPersonalWorkspaces.metaDescription: Accept or decline workspace invitations, and leave a workspace you no longer need.

SettingsWorkspaceGeneral.description: What {workspace} is called, and the time boundary its shared reporting is measured against.
SettingsWorkspaceGeneral.metaDescription: Rename this workspace and set the time zone its shared reporting uses.

SettingsPeople.accessCheckFailedBody: This is a problem reading your permissions, not a decision about them. Try again in a moment.
SettingsPeople.description: Who belongs to {workspace}, what each role can do, and who may join without an invite.
SettingsPeople.directoryDescription: Look someone up, then open their page to see their work. Only members who have accepted their invitation appear here; anyone still pending is listed under Members, above.
SettingsPeople.directoryFailedBody: Nobody's access changed. The list itself didn't load, so try again in a moment.
SettingsPeople.metaDescription: Manage members, roles, allowed domains, and the member directory for this workspace.

SettingsCommunications.description: How {workspace} sends mail: the server behind its own messages, the service behind its campaigns, and what it decides on its members' behalf.
SettingsCommunications.metaDescription: Set up this workspace's mail server, campaign delivery, and notification defaults.
SettingsCommunications.notificationDefaultsDescription: The notification settings this workspace would choose for its members before they change their own.
SettingsCommunications.notificationDefaultsGapBody: A workspace can't set notification defaults for its members yet — everyone chooses their own, and nothing here overrides them. Yours are on your notification preferences.

SettingsWorkspaceDataPrivacy.description: How relationship history that already exists elsewhere gets into {workspace}.
SettingsWorkspaceDataPrivacy.metaDescription: Import existing relationship history into this workspace.

SettingsCrm.accessCheckFailedBody: This is a problem reading your permissions, not a decision about them. Try again in a moment.
SettingsCrm.approvalPoliciesFailedBody: No policy changed. The list itself didn't load, so try again in a moment.
SettingsCrm.customFieldsDescription: Extra details this workspace records on its companies, contacts, and deals, beyond the fields Connex ships with.
SettingsCrm.description: How {workspace} shapes its records: the details they carry, how a contact is judged, what needs approval, and what runs on its own.
SettingsCrm.metaDescription: Set up custom fields, qualification criteria, approval policies, and automation for this workspace.
SettingsCrm.workflowsDescription: The automation that acts on these records when something changes or on a schedule.
SettingsCrm.workflowsGapBody: Workflows are built and turned on from their own surface, not from settings. There is nothing to configure here yet.

SettingsAuditDiagnostics.auditFailedBody: Nothing was hidden from you and nothing was lost. The log itself didn't load, so try again in a moment.
SettingsAuditDiagnostics.description: What has happened in {workspace}, and whether the services it depends on are healthy.
SettingsAuditDiagnostics.diagnosticsDescription: The state of this workspace's mail, background jobs, and stored credentials, with the deployment settings behind them.
SettingsAuditDiagnostics.metaDescription: Review this workspace's audit log and check the health of the services behind it.

SettingsOrgGeneral.description: What {organization} is called, the workspaces beneath it, and how either of them ends.
SettingsOrgGeneral.metaDescription: Rename your organization, see the workspaces under it, and export or delete them.

SettingsOrgIdentity.description: Who administers {organization}, who may be invited into its workspaces, and how they sign in.
SettingsOrgIdentity.metaDescription: Manage organization administrators, allowed email domains, and single sign-on.
SettingsOrgIdentity.ssoCheckFailedBody: Nothing changed and nothing is switched off. We couldn't read whether this instance has single sign-on, so try again in a moment.

SettingsOrgAi.description: The AI provider {organization} brings, what its workspaces may do with it, and how much it may spend in a day.
SettingsOrgAi.metaDescription: Configure your organization's AI provider, workspace controls, and daily limit.

SettingsOrgDataRequests.description: Requests from the people in {organization}'s records to see, correct, or stop the use of their own data.
SettingsOrgDataRequests.metaDescription: Track requests to see, correct, or stop the use of personal data, and assemble disclosure exports.

SettingsOrgAuditDiagnostics.description: What has happened above {organization}'s workspaces, and whether the services behind them are healthy.
SettingsOrgAuditDiagnostics.metaDescription: Review the organization audit log and check the health of the services behind it.
SettingsOrgAuditDiagnostics.diagnosticsDescription: The state of this organization's background jobs, stored credentials, and provider readiness, with the deployment settings behind them.
